narrative: 第一眼的可读性是一种生存问题。一张与墙面同色的脸会消失不见，
一件与街道同色的深色大衣也会消失不见。除非“寻找”本身就是这场戏的重点（伪装、狙击手、幽灵），否则观众不应被迫去搜寻主体。
如果解决方式只是给每个镜头都加一圈假光环，这就不是对的工具。有时候故事想表达的正是主体与背景无法分离：一个被办公室吞没的职员，一个被人群吞没的舞者，
此时你是在刻意构图这种“融合”。干净的边缘会有所帮助，
而脏乱的边缘和繁复的壁纸则会干扰图底关系，除非主体拥有更强的“货币”：逆光轮廓、色彩，或一处焦点区域。
how: 把主体安放在一个更简单或截然相反的背景之前。轮廓光或逆光能勾勒出外形线条。
浅景深的焦平面能让背景虚化融合。换一套服装（深色配浅色背景，浅色配深色背景，或一件单独的饱和色）比重新搭建一套布景更省事。
做一次眯眼测试：如果你眯起眼睛看，剪影就消失了，说明这种分离效果不够强。提示词：Clear figure-ground separation of [Subject] from background, contrast of tone, color, or focus so the person reads instantly.
when: 在任何一个人物必须被立刻找到的场景中，把它当作默认选择：常规覆盖镜头、海报画面，以及任何不是捉迷藏性质的段落。不要把一个理应被房间吞没的角色刻意分离出来。
vs: 剪影（Silhouette）是一种极端版本：人物作为轮廓出现在更明亮的背景前，牺牲了内部细节。浅焦（Shallow Focus）则用光学手段来购买这种分离效果。
图底关系也可以是一幅锐利、深景深的画面，运用影调对比来实现。影调对比（Tonal Contrast）是明暗两极的图形化极端版本。
浮雕光（Cameo Lighting）用一束光斑在黑暗中孤立主体。建筑纹理（Architexture）则可能是刻意让人物消失在建筑之中。
examples_film: 经典好莱坞摄影把即时的分离感当作一种礼仪：轮廓光、逆光和服装对比，让一张脸在影院银幕上依然清晰可读；西部片常把人物安置在天空之前。
黑色电影则把人物安置在潮湿的高光之前。当一部电影刻意不做这种分离时，通常是一种隐藏手法，而不是失误。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是一套与墙面同色的西装。破绽是观众必须去搜寻那颗头。
修正方法：加一道轮廓光、换一个不同明度的背景、更换服装，或使用浅焦。如果人物本就应该消失，就坦然接受，不要再声称这是一张肖像。

faq.q: 电影中的图底关系（Figure-Ground）是什么？
faq.a: 它是主体与背景之间的分离，使人物能被立刻读出。明度、色彩或焦点都可以完成这项任务。如果人物和墙面共享同一明度，构图就没有把他们分离开来。

faq.q: 图底关系（Figure-Ground）与剪影（Silhouette）有何区别？
faq.a: 剪影是把图底关系推向极致的轮廓化处理：背景更亮，身体内部则陷入黑暗。图底关系也包括在更暗或更柔和的背景前，一张被完整照亮的脸。剪影牺牲了脸部细节，图底关系则可能保留它。

faq.q: 什么时候该用图底关系（Figure-Ground）？
faq.a: 默认情况下，只要观众必须一眼就找到这个人，就该使用它。如果伪装、人群或建筑应当把他们吞没，就不要使用它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写图底关系（Figure-Ground）的提示词？
faq.a: 说明分离的方式。示例：Clear figure-ground separation of [Subject] from background, contrast of tone, color, or focus so the person reads instantly。加上“雪地前的深色大衣”，或“浅焦”，或“轮廓光”。AI模型经常会把主体和壁纸混在一起。

narrative: First read is survival. A face against a matching wall disappears.
A dark coat against a dark street disappears. The audience should not have to hunt the subject unless hunting is the beat (camouflage, a sniper, a ghost).
It is the wrong tool to solve with a fake halo on every shot. Sometimes the story is that they do not separate: a clerk eaten by an office, a dancer eaten by a crowd.
Then you are composing fusion on purpose. Clean edges help.
Dirty edges and busy wallpaper fight figure-ground unless the figure has a stronger currency: backlight rim, color, or a pool of focus.
how: Park the subject against a simpler or opposite field. A rim or backlight traces the outline.
A shallow plane of focus melts the ground. A costume change (dark on light, light on dark, a single saturated piece) is cheaper than a new set.

Check a squint test: if the silhouette dies when you defocus your eyes, the split is weak. Prompt: Clear figure-ground separation of [Subject] from background, contrast of tone, color, or focus so the person reads instantly.
when: Use it as default whenever a person must be found immediately: coverage, posters, any beat that is not hide-and-seek. Do not separate a character who is meant to be eaten by the room.
vs: Silhouette is a hard version: figure as outline against a brighter field, interior detail sacrificed. Shallow Focus buys separation with optics.
Figure-ground can also be a sharp, deep picture with tonal contrast. Tonal Contrast is the graphic extreme of lightest versus darkest mass.
Cameo Lighting isolates with a pool against dark. Architexture may intentionally lose the person in the building.
examples_film: Classical cinematography treats instant separation as manners: rim, backlight, and costume contrast so a face reads in a theater. Westerns park figures against sky.
Noir parks them against wet highlights. When a film withholds the split, it is usually a hide, not a mistake.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a matching suit on a matching wall. The tell is a hunt for the head.
The fix is a rim, a different backdrop value, a costume change, or Shallow Focus. If they should vanish, own it and stop claiming a portrait.

faq.a: It is the split between the subject and the field so the figure reads immediately. Tone, color, or focus can do the job. If the person and the wall share a value, the composition has not separated them.

A silhouette is figure-ground taken to outline: the field is brighter, the interior of the body goes dark. Figure-ground also includes a fully lit face against a darker or softer field. Silhouette sacrifices face for shape. Figure-ground may keep the face.
By default, whenever the audience must find the person in a glance. Withhold it when camouflage, crowd, or architecture should swallow them.

faq.q: How do I prompt figure-ground for AI image or video?
faq.a: State how they separate. Example: Clear figure-ground separation of [Subject] from background, contrast of tone, color, or focus so the person reads instantly. Add dark coat against snow, or shallow focus, or rim light. Models often blend subject and wallpaper.
